newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peking App offers 64.75 mln shrs at HK$1.00 each.
newsitem.headline: Peking App offers 64.75 mln shrs at HK$1.00 each.

text.p: Hong Kong leather garments manufacturer Peking Apparel International Group Ltd said on Monday it would issue 64.75 million new shares, or 25 percent of the group's enlarged share capital, at HK$1.00 per share.
The shares are offered with warrants in the proportion of one warrant for every five shares subscribed, it said in a statement.
Peking Apparel said the issue price represents a price-earnings ratio of 5.7 times on a weighted average basis and 6.8 times on a proforma fully-diluted basis.
The initial public offer will run from February 25-28, with dealing in the shares expected to start on March 7, it said.
Citicorp International Ltd is the sponsor, manager and underwriter of the issue.
The company said the issue would raise net proceeds of about HK$53.8 million.

About HK$10 million will be used to establish or acquire an interest in a tannery and HK$15 million used to set up representative offices and showrooms in the Chinese cities of Beijing, Tsingdao, Chengdu, Harbin and Guangzhou, it said.
Another HK$10 million would be used to repay bank loans, HK$3.0 million to upgrade manufacturing facilities and HK$15.8 million for working capital, it said.
Peking Apparel forecast profit after tax but before extraordinary itmes of not less than HK$35 million for the year ending March 31.
It posted net profit of HK$27.9 million on turnover of HK$290.90 million for the year ended March 31, 1996.
Sales from the China market accounted for about 54 percent of its total turnover in 1995/96.
Peking Apparel designs, makes and sells leather garments, fur coats and microfibre coats.
The majority of the company's leather and fur garments are manufactured at its factory in Shenzhen.
